replay.detail: No projection replay or launch replay is introduced.

schema.detail: Within the version-19 owner-local ledger installation, two per-subject expression indexes order operations and verified incarnations by immutable original physical-request local position. The new tables are empty on a version-18 upgrade, so these indexes do not scan existing claim/runtime history. Ledger JSON additionally retains exact request/control and runtime-observation snapshots and typed closure proof. No additional storage-version increment or replicated schema change. A local singleton generation and ledger mutation triggers fence synchronous physical observation captures, without a history scan and with replay/forget preservation.

rules.detail: No replicated claim or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Start receipts carry writer-set operation_status verified only after exact operation/incarnation verification, and producer-closed only after positive exact producer closure. Ordinary failure cannot forge a closure label or success. Request/result runtime kind, ID, operation, original desired token and evidence are bound in the completion transaction; conflicting inputs are refused. Native retirement uses the separately classified retired status. Existing fields and claim kinds are used; UUID shape alone is never proof, and capability advertisement remains unchanged. Admission validates prepared declaration kind/body in the same token-CAS snapshot and atomically appends requester control and physical requests. The physical guard rechecks unchanged, unrepaired original receipt snapshots. Permanent owner results retain deterministic typed never-dispatched/producer-closed, exact-operation-ended or retired proofs with original request identities and actual incarnation distinct from prior target. Verified starts retain the authoritative runtime.observed ClaimRecord and canonical sortable key; delayed launcher completion preserves an already-observed exact running incarnation. UUID text, absent receipts and cleanup flags remain insufficient proof. Owner reconciliation refuses a prior expected incarnation, and generation-fences differing/absent-incarnation snapshots after a verified distinct actual incarnation; fresh native PTY absence explicitly clears the old incarnation instead of backfilling it, still advances normal reconciliation, and remains insufficient closure proof; the proof lookup uses original request position through the partial verified-operation index.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the normal deployment restart already classified for the start-operation upgrade.

manual.detail: Consumers must verify exact operation/request/runtime/incarnation bindings along with the writer proof status. This integration obligation introduces no new operator command.

recovery.detail: The separately classified database and runtime-state restoration procedure applies; this change adds no separate migration.
